findings.title: Required integration and browser regression gates are absent from CI execution
findings.rationale: The CI workflow runs API lint/build/unit tests and Web build/unit tests only; it does not run API E2E against PostgreSQL or Playwright. The command-parity evidence explicitly confirms that no root CI PG-E2E or Playwright job is asserted. The new critical protections—including adapter fences, cross-tenant mutation checks, and the causally synchronized A→B→A draft regression—therefore rely solely on the local all80903 run. This leaves future regressions able to merge without executing the tests that substantiate the changed contract.
findings.suggested_action: Add a project-owned CI job that invokes the canonical all runner or an equivalent isolated Node 22/PostgreSQL/served-bundle Chromium workflow, retaining source and bundle freshness attestation. Do not replace it with mocks or a retry-only gate; if CI expansion is outside authorized scope, record an explicit approval-authority waiver and leave the required audit gate unsatisfied until then.
